result.summary: The interface displays several logical and layout inconsistencies, primarily involving filter functionality and text presentation.

issues.description: The active 'Pizza' category filter fails to refine results, showing Ramen and Burgers instead.
issues.suggestion: Synchronize category selection with the displayed content feed.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' is clipped due to lack of space.
issues.suggestion: Implement text wrapping or horizontal scrolling for long titles.

issues.description: Generic vector illustrations are used as placeholders for food items.
issues.suggestion: Replace graphical assets with high-resolution food photography.
